description:
Answer a question about one of the user's uploaded files.

    Reads the file's contents and returns LuBot's answer: numbers computed
    from CSV / Excel tables, or text found in PDF, Word and image files, with
    the file named as the source. Use this when the user asks about one
    specific file; get the file_id from list_files first. Don't use it to
    compare several files at once.

    Limits: requires sign-in; counts toward the user's LuBot plan like a
    My Files question; one file per call; answers can take up to a minute;
    questions are capped at 2000 characters.
name: analyze_file

FileMeta.description:
Public-facing metadata for one file the caller owns.

`file_id` is an opaque string — never a raw DB primary key path or
filesystem path — so a compromised token can't be used to probe
internal storage layout.
FileMeta.title: FileMeta

outputSchema.description:
Return type for `analyze_file`.

MARKET-17 S5b-4: `narrative` is the web My Files engine's answer when
`data_status == "ok"`, else a clear message. `citations` = the file the
answer is about. `chart` stays None (the engine's chart isn't safe to
read from the shared agent). `confidence` is None unless real.
outputSchema.title: AnalysisResult

title: Analyze a File
